title: Sardegna: coasts, islands and Cagliari
summary: 12 day plans over 11 dates, in three bases: the wild east coast, the northeast islands and Cagliari with its southern beaches.
note: Sample itinerary for exploration; confirm current access and bookings before travelling.

phases.title: Ogliastra
phases.subtitle: Wild east coast. Hotel Orri, Tortolì, 3 nights.

days.title: Arrival and Arbatax sunset

stops.name: Hotel Orri: check in
stops.desc: Drop bags, head out. Rooftop bar for sunset.

stops.name: Rocce Rosse, Arbatax
stops.desc: 10 min. Red porphyry rocks at the harbour. Free. Golden hour. Sneakers for scrambling.

stops.name: Santa Maria Navarrese
stops.desc: Optional. Fishing village. 1000-year-old olive tree. Sunset aperitivo. Scout the Day 3 boat port.

tips: Easy evening, you have just arrived.
days.food: Tortolì: culurgiones (stuffed pasta), porceddu (suckling pig). Ask the hotel.

days.title: Pedra Longa and Selvaggio Blu hike

stops.name: Pedra Longa
stops.desc: 30 min. 128 m sea stack. Swim or snorkel at the base. Cliff jumping. Restaurant at the top.

stops.name: Selvaggio Blu hike
stops.desc: Italy's most famous coastal trail. The first 2 to 3 km are jaw-dropping. Turn back at any point. The full trail is a technical expedition, so do only the introductory section.

stops.name: Gorropu Canyon (alternative)
stops.desc: Europe's deepest gorge, with 500 m limestone walls. 40 min drive from Tortolì, near Urzulei. 2 to 3 h hike along a riverbed between towering cliffs. Full half-day. Choose this or Selvaggio Blu, not both.

tips: Start early: the coast is exposed by noon.
1.5 L water, sun protection, proper shoes.
Optional alternative: Gorropu Canyon, a full half-day canyon walk instead of the coastal trail.
days.food: Pedra Longa restaurant after the hike, with an extraordinary terrace view.

days.title: Boat cruise: Goloritzé, Mariolu and more

stops.name: Santa Maria Navarrese port
stops.desc: Arrive 30 min before. The boat leaves at 9 AM sharp. Max 12 passengers.

stops.name: Caves and fjords cruise
stops.desc: North along the Baunei coast. Sea caves are reachable only by boat.

stops.name: Cala Goloritzé
stops.desc: UNESCO site. 30 m visibility. 143 m pinnacle. Swim from the boat.

stops.name: Piscine di Venere
stops.desc: Natural turquoise pools. Quick swim.

stops.name: Cala Mariolu
stops.desc: 1.5 h. White pebbles, turquoise water, fish. Water shoes and snorkel.

stops.name: Cala Biriala
stops.desc: 1.5 h. Calm waters. Grotta del Fico is optional, about €10.

stops.name: Cala dei Gabbiani
stops.desc: 1.5 h. Wild and remote. Last stop.

stops.name: Return to port
stops.desc: Back around 5 PM.

tips: Pack snacks or lunch.
Snorkel gear, water shoes, sunscreen.

days.title: Ghost village, then Budoni

stops.name: Gairo Vecchio
stops.desc: 45 min south. Ruins and fig trees, abandoned in 1951. SS198 from Gairo Sant'Elena. Free. Check safe public access to the ruins.

stops.name: Castello della Fava, Posada
stops.desc: Hilltop castle. €4. Charming village below.

stops.name: Hotel Castello, Budoni
stops.desc: Pool and sea views.

tips: Check out of Hotel Orri by 11 AM.
About 2.5 h of driving in total.

phases.title: Northeast
phases.subtitle: Islands and wild beaches. Hotel Castello, Budoni, 3 nights.

days.title: La Cinta beach (afternoon)

stops.name: La Cinta Beach
stops.desc: 15 min. Huge white sand beach. Walk south. €1.50 per hour parking.

tips: Easy afternoon.

days.title: Hidden beaches and Tavolara views

stops.name: Spiaggia delle Vacche
stops.desc: Rough road. Go before 10 AM. Hidden coves past the main beach. No facilities.

stops.name: Capo Coda Cavallo
stops.desc: Tavolara across the strait. Snorkeling. Free parking.

stops.name: Sa Curcurica Lagoon (add-on)
stops.desc: Coastal lagoon near Orosei, 30 min south of Budoni. Flamingos, herons and other birdlife. Nice for an early morning walk or a sunset detour. Free, open access.

tips: Rough roads mean fewer people.
Optional: Sa Curcurica lagoon near Orosei, good early morning or at sunset.

days.title: La Maddalena archipelago

stops.name: Drive to Palau
stops.desc: 1 h 40. Leave early. Port parking about €10.

stops.name: Palau port check-in
stops.desc: €5 landing tax, cash.

stops.name: Isola di Santa Maria
stops.desc: Turquoise shallows.

stops.name: Budelli natural pools
stops.desc: Pink Beach seen from the boat. Swim at the pools. The highlight of the day.

stops.name: Spargi: Cala Granara
stops.desc: White sand, calm snorkeling.

stops.name: La Maddalena town
stops.desc: 1 h free time. Harbour, gelato, wine.

stops.name: Return to Budoni
stops.desc: 1 h 40 drive back.

tips: June has fewer boats.
€5 landing tax, cash.

phases.title: Cagliari
phases.subtitle: City, cliffs and beaches. Cagliari, 4 nights.

days.title: City: Castello, market and Poetto

stops.name: Castello Quarter
stops.desc: Medieval heart. Cathedral (free, with crypt). Torre dell'Elefante €3. Wander without rushing.

stops.name: Bastione di Saint Remy
stops.desc: Sweeping views over the rooftops, port and sea. Free.

stops.name: San Benedetto Market
stops.desc: Seafood, bottarga, oysters on the spot. Mon to Sat 7 AM to 2 PM. Closed Sunday.

stops.name: Sella del Diavolo hike
stops.desc: The Devil's Saddle above Poetto. Trailhead at Calamosca. 40 min up. Panoramic views over the Gulf of Cagliari.

stops.name: Poetto sunset swim
stops.desc: 8 km of white sand. Walk south for space. Bars everywhere. Bus PF or PQ from the centre, 20 min, €1.30.

tips: Car-free day.
The market closes at 2 PM.
Sella del Diavolo hike: bring water and sneakers. See it from above today and from the sea on Day 11.
days.food: Market lunch. Marina dinner: fregola con arselle, bottarga pasta, seadas with honey.

days.title: South: Nora, Tuerredda and Cipolla

stops.name: Nora Archaeological Park
stops.desc: 45 min. Phoenician and Roman headland. Mosaics. €10, guided, 1 h.

stops.name: Tuerredda
stops.desc: Book online the day before, by 8 AM (€2). Parking €10. Island to swim to.

stops.name: Cala Cipolla
stops.desc: Intimate cove. The right-hand rocks are best for snorkeling. €8 parking.

tips: Nora is optional: 1 h, on the route.
Tuerredda: book the day before by 8 AM.
The SS195 coast road is stunning.
days.food: Beach picnic or restaurants at Chia.

bookings.label: Tuerredda entry, €2 per person, book the day before

days.title: West: Nebida and Porto Pino

stops.name: Nebida to Masua hike
stops.desc: 1 h 15 west. Cliff trail, Pan di Zucchero 133 m stack, mining ruins. About 1.5 h.

stops.name: Masua Beach
stops.desc: Swim below the 133 m stack. Porto Flavia is optional, €10, 30 min.

stops.name: Dune di Porto Pino
stops.desc: Massive dunes, turquoise water. €8 to €10. Gates close at 7 PM.

tips: Rugged and cinematic.
Proper shoes.
Porto Flavia: a tunnel to a cliff view.

days.title: East: Sinzias, Porto Giunco and boat tour

stops.name: Cala Sinzias
stops.desc: 1 h east. Spacious, crystal-clear water. €10 parking.

stops.name: Porto Giunco
stops.desc: The star of the day. A tower between two bays. Climb for the view and flamingos. €10.

stops.name: Sella del Diavolo boat tour (3 h)
stops.desc: Back in Cagliari for the afternoon. 4 swim stops in hidden bays, snorkeling inside sea caves, aperitivo on board. Max 12. You hike this headland from above on Day 8 and see it from the sea today.

stops.name: Farewell dinner
stops.desc: Last proper evening in Cagliari. Marina district. Make it special.

tips: Tower hike 15 min, the best photo in the south of Sardegna.
Leave Porto Giunco by 1:30 PM to be back for the 3 PM boat (about 1 h drive).
The big finale day: beaches, hike, boat, dinner.
days.food: Villasimius: bottarga pasta for lunch. Farewell dinner in the Marina district.

bookings.label: Sella del Diavolo boat, about €35 to €45

days.title: Departure

stops.name: Final morning
stops.desc: Poetto swim or Calamosca (10 min, popular with locals). Airport 15 min.

tips: Calamosca for a final swim.
